prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering onboarding by moving sign-in after adoption selection was effective (+12.0%) and accurately predicted.
Redesigning adoption selection (live pet preview) showed no clear effect, with predictions (+8.0%) being too high.
Adding desktop visibility diagnostics and alerts (notifications) showed no clear effect, overestimating impact (+5.0% predicted).
Animated mascot app intro changes (copy/choose_path) showed no clear effect, and predictions (+3.0%) were too high.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: -4.1% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +0.2% over 1 test(s)
- home, notification: -2.9% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +12.0% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 81.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] Interactive Trait Selector Waiting Screen: Add an interactive trait selection checklist and progress estimate to the waiting screen while desktop pet assets build. (why: The waiting step has high latency (median 201s, mean 2336s), causing users to abandon before completion.)
1: [finish, redesign] Desktop Controls Interactive Guide: Redesign home_intro into a stage layout with step-by-step guidance on how to drag, hide, and interact with the desktop pet. (why: 3 support tickets reported confusion on how to control or hide the pet after onboarding, and finish completion is low (64.8%).)
2: [choose_path, layout] Two-Column Path Choice Layout: Change the choose_path screen layout to a clean two-column format balancing ready-made adoption against custom pet creation. (why: Choose_path has a 76.2% conversion rate with a long mean time of 514s, indicating layout confusion when selecting a route.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Account Persistence Safety Notice: Add clear messaging on the sign-in screen reassuring users that signing in preserves pet customization across sessions. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or resetting after signing in again.)
4: [adoption, new_screen] Pre-Adoption Workstyle Match Quiz: Insert a new interactive trait quiz screen before pet selection to recommend suitable companion personalities. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 60.9% with 1017s mean time; structured suggestions ease choice paralysis.)
5: [home, notification] Background Notification Readiness Toggle: Enable background notifications on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet assets finish loading. (why: Mean waiting time is 2336s; notifying users allows them to minimize the app without abandoning setup.)
6: [finish, hint] System Tray Quick Access Hint: Add a visual hint on the final onboarding screen highlighting the system tray icon position for easy pet management. (why: Support mail highlighted user confusion about how to control or hide the pet post-onboarding.)
7: [choose_path, reorder] Story-First Guided Onboarding Sequence: Ensure the story screen plays immediately before path selection to establish emotional value before choices are made. (why: Choose_path conversion is 76.2% with a long mean duration of 514s; story framing upfront increases user intent.)
8: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Refresh Troubleshooter: Add a fallback retry action component and diagnostic hint on the sign-in screen. (why: 2 support tickets reported the sign-in screen stalling or failing to render properly.)

scores.note: Interactive waiting screen may alleviate drop-off caused by extreme latency.
High support evidence, but complex redesigns historically underperformed.
Layout tweak targets high mean selection duration with modest confidence.
Strong support mail backing and easy copy-only implementation.
Adoption drop-off is high, but adding new screens risks adding drop-off.
Home notifications previously produced a -2.9% relative drop.
Low cost hint addressing post-onboarding confusion from support feedback.
Reordering onboarding sequences has proven high effectiveness (+12.0%).
Diagnostic fallback addresses explicit sign-in stalling support tickets.
